title: P1: CoAP proxy incomplete request option forwarding
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/proxy.py (lines 88-90)

The proxy only forwards content_format but not other standard CoAP options. Missing:
- Accept (wrong response format)
- If-Match, If-None-Match (conditional requests fail)
- Block1, Block2 (blockwise transfers fail silently)
- Observe (observation fails)

Impact: Clients using these features experience silent failures.

Fix: Forward all safe-to-proxy options per RFC 7252 section 5.7.2.
